name: BLiMP
description: A challenge set for evaluating the linguistic knowledge of language models on major grammatical phenomena in English, consisting of 67 datasets each with 1,000 minimal pairs contrasting grammatical acceptability.
reputation: A widely used and influential benchmark for syntactic knowledge in language models, especially for probing grammatical acceptability.
notes: Data generated from linguist-crafted grammar templates with high human agreement; evaluates models by their ability to assign higher probability to acceptable sentences.
